tool.name: nf-core miniasm
tool.description: A very fast OLC-based de novo assembler for noisy long reads
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ miniasm \\ $args \\ -f $reads \\ $paf > \\ ${prefix}.gfa
awk '/^S/{print ">"\$2"\\n"\$3}' "${prefix}.gfa" | fold > ${prefix}.fasta
gzip -n ${prefix}.gfa gzip -n ${prefix}.fasta
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": miniasm: \$( miniasm -V 2>&1 ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
